name: Zapper Fuel

faq.answer: Larion awaits the delivery at Marshal's Refuge.
faq.q: Who needs the zapper fuel delivered?

faq.answer: The device requires five samples of Atal'ai Haze alongside the Unloaded Zapper.
faq.q: What is needed for the zapper fuel?

faq.answer: The Unloaded Zapper is the unpowered mechanical device brought to Larion along with fuel.
Marshal's Refuge is the encampment where Larion takes delivery of the Unloaded Zapper and its fuel.

sections.body: While Marvon is away, Liv Rizzlefix gives you one of her zapper prototypes, though its fuel must be gathered from the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Once you collect five samples of Atal'ai Haze, you carry both the Unloaded Zapper and its charge to Larion at Marshal's Refuge.
sections.title: Supplying the Device

summary: Liv Rizzlefix asks you to carry her Unloaded Zapper to Larion at Marshal's Refuge. Five samples of Atal'ai Haze from the Temple of Atal'Hakkar are needed to charge it.
